package.description: A headless terminal CLI + daemon for driving, asserting on, and recording shells

en-US.description: A headless terminal CLI + daemon for driving, asserting on, and recording shells
en-US.name: shell-use
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- build: update Homebrew formula to 0.1.0 by cpendery (@cpendery) in #254
- feat: add Go support by Meza (@meza) in #208
- build(deps): bump taiki-e/install-action from 2.87.20 to 2.87.22 in the github-actions group by Dependabot (@dependabot)[bot] in #257
- Pin GitHub Actions to full-length commit SHAs by Dan Fiedler (@danfiedler-msft) in #256
- fix(recording): capture frames from the live session emulator by Ayman Bagabas (@aymanbagabas) in #258
- build(deps): bump the github-actions group with 4 updates by Dependabot (@dependabot)[bot] in #262
- feat(render): style screenshots and recordings from the config, per profile by Ayman Bagabas (@aymanbagabas) in #220
- feat: share the native engine across language bindings by Ayman Bagabas (@aymanbagabas) in #259
- docs: note ConPTY input translation for write() on Windows by Paolo Valletta (@paoValle) in #261
- fix: prepare Homebrew update branches for maintainers by cpendery (@cpendery) in #265
- build(deps): bump the github-actions group with 2 updates by Dependabot (@dependabot)[bot] in #266
- feat: add native scrollback viewport scrolling by Ayman Bagabas (@aymanbagabas) in #263
- feat(go): bundle native engines in module releases by Ayman Bagabas (@aymanbagabas) in #264
- chore: bump release version to 0.1.1 by cpendery (@cpendery) in #267
- fix: repair Python release wheel builds by cpendery (@cpendery) in #268
- fix: remove QEMU from ARM GNU native release builds by cpendery (@cpendery) in #269

New Contributors
- Paolo Valletta (@paoValle) made their first contribution in #261
